subject: Save output of getCorrelation function to object

messages.author: ee6cd27fcc6eafbe
messages.subject: Save output of getCorrelation function to object
parts:
Hello - I'm sorry this is probably a simple question but I haven't been able to find a solution. I am trying to save the output of the getCorrelation function, but assignment using <- doesn't seem to be working. 

Example using included sample data:

file.list=list( system.file("extdata",
                            "test1.myCpG.txt", package = "methylKit"),
                system.file("extdata",
                            "test2.myCpG.txt", package = "methylKit"),
                system.file("extdata",
                            "control1.myCpG.txt", package = "methylKit"),
                system.file("extdata",
                            "control2.myCpG.txt", package = "methylKit") )

myobj=methRead(file.list,
           sample.id=list("test1","test2","ctrl1","ctrl2"),
           assembly="hg18",
           treatment=c(1,1,0,0),
           context="CpG",
           mincov = 10
           )

sample_merged <- methylKit::unite(myobj, destrand=FALSE)
sample_correlation <- getCorrelation(sample_merged, plot = FALSE))

The output of getCorrelation is printed to the terminal, but the object sample_correlation is NULL. I am using an RMarkdown document within RStudio, but it doesn't seem to work in command-line R either. 

Thank you very much for your work on the package

Patrick
